decisions.basis: Level 3.1 roadmap still contains a field-usability stage whose real evidence is not established by this audit.
Current compositional intelligence preserves the frozen human_judgment enum and separates provenance, availability, consideration, authority and responsibility without a machine-level rename.
Field usability requires actual field cases; semantic implementation or synthetic tests are not substitute field evidence.
Current review cues are purpose-relative, non-scalar, non-blocking and interface-local; they expose unknowns without mutating PoAI JSON or inferring facts.

The legacy Level 4 architecture discovery family is superseded by current reusable binding/attestation and later identity/authority/materialization successor surfaces while preserving claim separation.

The signature-binding RFC is implemented and the successor map classifies its deterministic-binding/signature family as SUPERSEDED_BY current reusable infrastructure without upgrading identity, authority, truth or canonicality.
